title: Proposed Expense Limit Increases (Draft)
content: DRAFT — FOR DISCUSSION ONLY. This proposal has not been approved or implemented. Proposal: the client entertainment expense limit for Operations Division employees would be raised from $150 to $250 per event, aligning it closer to the Sales Division limit. The Finance team is reviewing whether this change is fiscally sustainable given current budget projections. No employee should rely on these proposed limits; the current official limits in expense_policy_ops remain in effect. A decision is expected in Q4 2026. This draft was circulated to department heads for comment on September 1, 2026.
